transcript.content: Hello, it’s nice to meet you. What brings you in today?

Hello. I've been struggling a lot lately because I feel like once I start eating at night after work, I just can’t stop or control how much I’m eating. It has gotten to the point where it feels completely out of my hands, and I really need some help with it.
After these episodes of eating at night, do you ever try to make up for it by vomiting, using laxatives, fasting, or exercising a lot? About how often does this happen?

No, I've never tried to throw up, use laxatives, or exercise to make up for it; instead, I just feel completely frozen, disgusted, and ashamed, usually sitting there scrolling through my phone to distract myself. These out-of-control nights have been happening at least a couple of times every week for about the last three months.

During these nighttime episodes, do you eat an unusually large amount of food within a short period, like within about 2 hours, and feel unable to stop or control what you’re eating? Are these episodes also linked with things like eating very quickly, eating until uncomfortably full, eating when you’re not physically hungry, eating alone because of embarrassment, or feeling very guilty afterward?

Yes, that describes my experience perfectly. I'll order enough delivery for three or four people—like pizza, pasta, sides, and dessert—and eat it all alone on autopilot, shoveling it in so fast I barely taste it. I keep going until my stomach is painfully tight and I feel sick, leaving me feeling deeply disgusted and ashamed afterward.

final_diagnosis.reason: The patient reports recurrent binge-eating episodes characterized by eating an objectively large amount of food within a discrete period, loss of control, rapid eating, eating until uncomfortably full, and marked shame/disgust afterward. Episodes occur at least a couple of times per week for about 3 months. There are no compensatory behaviors such as vomiting, laxatives, fasting, or excessive exercise. This presentation is most consistent with binge-eating disorder, coded under ICD-10 F50.8.
